status: Retrospective implementation correction after leakage was found; neither the correction nor the original held-out data are prospectively blinded.
problem: Full-record circular shift mapped the first 1460 discovery inputs (1979) to held-out humidity in 2025 and contaminated placebo preprocessing and discovery fits.
replacement: Map the first 1460 humidity inputs (1979-01-01 00 through 1979-12-31 18) to 2018-01-01 00 through 2018-12-31 18, entirely inside discovery. For all later inputs use the actual value 365 days earlier. This train-only wrap is a wrong-year control warmup, not a chronological forecasting feature.
unchanged: Endpoint definitions, full-model MSE denominator, thresholds and decision rule
rerun_scope: All A/B/C per-lag, block, frozen-gain, band and CERES-substitution endpoints; only C series and its fitted preprocessing change.
limitations: Warmup pairs 1979 winds with later discovery-year humidity; the warmup is intentionally a nonchronological wrong-year control. No held-out humidity may enter any discovery placebo. Full workflow FDR calibration remains unestablished.
